title: Literal integral representatives for the common coefficient rationalization
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Padic l, D a finite-field datum, hl:l≠D.p, T a D.k-scheme (with no separatedness or finite-type requirement), and E a FieldStage. The object map of rationalization l Ω E T [def-sf-constructible-exceptional-coefficient-construction-data] is surjective. Residue Tor [lem-coef-integral-residue-tor] identifies the constructible integral objects with the finite-Tor integral objects; integralRepresentative [lem-sf-integral-adjunction-raw-localization] applied to the underlying object gives a literal preimage, not merely an isomorphic preimage.

source.place: Construction 6.2, the raw rational coefficient category retains the integral objects; Construction 6.6 uses these representatives.

proof.text: The base-field unit makes l invertible in every residue field of T. Residue Tor therefore identifies the integral constructible and finite-Tor predicates. Apply integralRepresentative to the underlying integral object of a rational object. It changes only a proof of membership; raw rationalization retains this object and proof irrelevance gives literal equality. This constructs a preimage for every rational object.
